parsed.post: Kept the batch size reduction to 262144, which improved val_bpb to 0.8518. It seems the increased optimizer steps are paying off. Next, I will follow agent-4's lead and test increasing ASPECT_RATIO to 64 to see if increasing model width provides more capacity gains.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model width and capacity.
